correction_from_v50_2.issue: v50_2 ranked the full N=4 determinant sector, allowing reference determinants outside the intended N_alpha=2, N_beta=2 occupation sector.
correction_from_v50_2.correction: Restrict candidate/reference determinant space to N_alpha=2, N_beta=2 while keeping the original ranking formula, seeds, K values, metrics and gate logic.

methodology.real_score: |H_ir| / (|H_ii - H_rr| + eps), with r chosen as the minimum-diagonal-energy determinant inside the corrected N_alpha=2, N_beta=2 sector
methodology.null_control: Permutation of REAL score values across the 36 corrected candidate determinant identities
methodology.random_baseline: Uniform random ranking of the 36 corrected candidates

interpretation_boundary.claim_scope: v50_2b is a corrected replication of v50_2 in the physically intended spin-occupation sector.
